title: Hearty Dense Dutch Tofu Stew
description: A winey, dense, quick-fix Dutch stew featuring hoisin sauce, simmered in a stone bowl and served on a cedar plank.
instructions: Preheat oven to 175°C and place a cedar plank on the rack for steam aroma.
In a large stone bowl, heat one tablespoon sesame oil over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger to the bowl and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add sliced onions and carrots to the bowl, cooking until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in sliced shiitake mushrooms, cooking until they release moisture, about 2 minutes.
Pour in 120 ml white wine, letting it reduce slightly for 2 minutes.
Add 500 ml vegetable broth and 60 ml hoisin sauce, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Gently fold in diced tofu cubes, then cover the bowl and let the stew simmer for 20 minutes to meld flavors.
Stir in 2 sliced green onion stalks and 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds just before serving.
Serve hot, placing the stone bowl directly on the cedar plank for an aromatic presentation.
